L8·N63unmasked layer
Sign-flipped boundary detector: it activates on tokens that close or bridge a clause mid-paragraph (sentence-final "." , comma, connective " and"/" regard"/" yesterday", or the start of a new referential phrase like " AB"), and is most strongly *suppressed* by the newline that follows a completed sentence (paragraph break) — i.e. it distinguishes in-line clause boundaries from hard line breaks rather than tracking any topic.
